features.title: Mill sourcing & open-book costing
features.body: We match your yarn construction, MOQ and price ceiling against mills we hold standing capacity with, and return an open cost comparison showing raw fiber %, CMT, dyeing and logistics — never an opaque markup.

features.title: Technical fit & sealed pre-production
features.body: Proto, fit, and pre-production samples run through our own on-site merchandisers. We review grading, balance shrinkage, and seal the pre-production sample before bulk yardage is touched.

features.title: Salaried on-site inline & final QC
features.body: Our own inspectors sit on the factory line during cutting, sewing and pressing, working to AQL 2.5 on majors and 1.5 on criticals — not a third-party checklist received weeks after the fact.

features.title: Accredited testing & chain of custody
features.body: GOTS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, BSCI, and Sedex SMETA 4-pillar certifications maintained with accredited SGS and Intertek lab test reports on file for every shipped production lot.
points: BSCI & Sedex labor audits on file

features.title: Freight, duty & customs clearance
features.body: FCL container contracts, LCL consolidation and chartered air freight quoted under clear Incoterms (FOB, CIF, or landed DDP), with destination duty classifications verified before the vessel sails.
points: Clear FOB, CIF, or landed DDP terms

features.title: Complete international trade documentation
features.body: Commercial invoice, itemized packing list, clean on-board ocean bill of lading, chamber certificate of origin, and preferential trade duty forms (GSP Form A / EUR.1) completed before sailing.
points: Chamber of Commerce certificates of origin

labTests.standard: Zero banned azo dyes, formaldehyde < 16 ppm
